registeredBeforeAnyScoring: Committed before a single LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga or Ligue 1 prediction was scored. EPL is scored only as the harness-parity control; its numbers were already public in reports/model-v1-evaluation.json.
purpose: Decide, per league, whether the model EPL already publishes may publish model-only match forecasts for LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga and Ligue 1 — on exactly the evidence EPL was published on, no more and no less.

whatIsBeingTested.model: epl-model-v1-split-poisson — lib/sports/epl/strength-state.mjs fitEplStrength + scoreMatrix with committed defaults (no shrinkage, no Dixon-Coles, no time decay). Applied to each league unchanged; nothing is tuned.
whatIsBeingTested.harness: lib/sports/soccer/walk-forward.mjs — EPL's protocol: walk forward by UTC calendar day, one pregame state per day fit on strictly earlier-dated matches, warm-up folded never scored, cold starts at league average.

baselines.elo: K=20, home advantage +60, P(draw) = running empirical draw rate
baselines.market: de-vigged market-average closing 1X2 — a REFERENCE, never an input

acceptanceBars.note: ALL must hold, per league, on the 2025-26 HOLDOUT, for that league to publish model-only forecasts. Any failure is a rejection for this model version and is recorded, not retried with a new bar.

bars.statement: Before any league verdict counts: EPL run through this harness reproduces reports/baseline-evaluation-v1.json per season (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) for empirical, elo and poisson within ±0.003 log loss. If it does not, every verdict below is VOID.
poisson holdout log loss ≤ empirical holdout log loss − 0.005
bars.why: The model must know something real about the clubs, by a margin — EPL clears this by 0.039 on 2025-26.

bars.statement: poisson holdout DRAW ECE (10-bin, the draw probability alone) ≤ 0.030
bars.why: A public probability must mean what it says. This is the calibration metric the EPL model card reports (drawEce 0.0262). All-outcome ECE is reported beside it, not gating.

bars.statement: poisson log loss ≤ empirical log loss − 0.005 on EACH development season too
bars.why: A single good season is not a model.

reportedNotGating.elo: poisson vs elo holdout log loss is reported. EPL's published model does NOT beat Elo on 2025-26 (1.045 vs 1.026), so gating other leagues on it would hold them to a standard EPL itself does not meet; it stays a disclosed limitation, exactly as for EPL.
reportedNotGating.market: model − market holdout log loss is reported. Every model in this repository has lost to the closing market; this comparison is never marketed as beating anything and never gates publication of a model-only forecast.
reportedNotGating.allOutcomeEce: poisson holdout all-outcome ECE is reported for every league (EPL control: 0.0516).

stoppingRule: One run per league for this version. A rejected league stays rejected for epl-model-v1-split-poisson; any variant (shrinkage, Dixon-Coles, decay, league-specific parameters) needs its own preregistration and a season nobody has looked at.
whatThisDoesNotTest: Player markets (Phase C, separate preregistration), prices, cross-league competitions, or whether any forecast beats the market.

amendments.was: poisson holdout ECE (10-bin, all outcome probabilities) ≤ 0.030
amendments.now: poisson holdout DRAW ECE (10-bin, the draw probability alone) ≤ 0.030
amendments.why: The v1 text named an all-outcome ECE but cited EPL's DRAW ECE (0.0262) as its reference. The H0 parity run on the EPL control showed the published EPL model's all-outcome holdout ECE is 0.0516 — so v1 would have held new leagues to a standard the EPL model does not meet, contradicting this registration's stated purpose ('exactly the evidence EPL was published on'). Amended to the metric the reference actually is.
amendments.whatWasSeen: ONLY the EPL control (already public in reports/model-v1-evaluation.json). No LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga or Ligue 1 prediction had been scored when this amendment was committed.
